scope: Native Blender views of supplied-hand replacement and wrist attachment; no game-render or universal collision claim.

directly_viewed_hand_images.finding: Both supplied hands show continuous cuff openings and source finger/nail anatomy; no exposed source cap or brown skin-piercing islands.
Palmar creases and all five digits remain visible. Previous brown wrist islands are absent on both hands.
Original supplied curl remains visible. The leather cuff encloses both wrists continuously.
All-joint maximum added flex no longer pushes skin strips or patches through either fixed cuff rim.
All five digits and their nails remain present; no obvious fingertip-through-palm intersection from this view. Pose reads as a curved grasp.
Rounded leather opening surrounds left wrist; source cutoff is enclosed and no visible gap appears at this camera.
Rounded leather opening surrounds right wrist; source cutoff is enclosed and no visible gap appears at this camera.

character_evidence_reused_from_iteration: Iteration03 character GLB is byte-identical to iteration02.
quantitative_result: 48 sections; 16,906 skin section points per hand and pose. Neutral and all-max-flex each have zero sampled penetrations, minimum inner-wall clearance 0.702 mm left and 0.521 mm right.
resolved_findings: Iteration01 visible wrist cutoff and brown sleeve/skin intersections.
Iteration02 maximum-flex wrist skin crossed fixed cuff rim; iteration03 guarded wrist weights/correctives resolved the visual and sampled-clearance regression.
remaining_notes: Small localized dark crease-like marks remain on dorsal source detail; this review did not isolate whether they arise from the sculpt, reduced geometry, or the normal bake.
The maximum normalized pose reads as a curved grasp with the supplied rest curl retained.
Finite camera views and radial samples do not prove collision-free contact for every animation or continuous intermediate state.
Runtime GPU/weapon contact validation is handled separately by the integration task.
